correlation_warning: minute observations are strongly serially correlated and are not independent statistical trials
data_source: immutable minute manifests and hash-addressed raw payloads recorded before this scoring protocol
inference_rule: report descriptive errors only; no p-value or independent-event claim from minute rows
market_edge_rule: no market edge is inferred from this signal test; executable market data is a separate later gate
missing_data_rule: fail closed for a pair if target, prior complete persistence, or numeric incomplete station values are unavailable
next_if_survives: define temporal development-validation-holdout split before any learned model or market-price test
predictor_baseline: latest canonical complete v with t strictly earlier than target t that was already visible in the same point-in-time manifest at first incomplete observation
predictor_primary: arithmetic mean of all numeric temp_f values in first observed latest_incomplete snapshot for the target t
rejection_rule: if survival_rule fails, reject this simple incomplete-mean signal formulation rather than tuning weights or station subsets on the same data
revision_rule: if target same-t revisions are observed, target remains last complete v visible within the immutable recorder window and revisions are reported separately
station_selection: none; include every numeric station temp_f present in first incomplete snapshot
survival_rule: primary incomplete-station-mean MAE must be lower than point-in-time previous-canonical persistence MAE overall and in at least two of the three cities
target: later canonical complete v for the same city and t; use last observed complete v in recorder window
